name: Ray Gigant
source: Ray Gigant is a unique dungeon crawler RPG which combines dungeon crawling adventure with Japanese visual novel like story telling. Players will first be introduced to the gripping tale of Ichiya who is a young fighter shrouded in mystery.
translation: 《神依骑士》是一款独特的迷宫探索RPG，将地牢冒险与日式视觉小说式叙事结合。玩家首先会接触神秘年轻战士天风一弥的扣人心弦故事。
